Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, facing street, fov 90
- arterial road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: center; parking: lot
- commercial building at center, 1 story, brick, glass, pitched roof, at-street setback
- utilities: power lines, utility poles
- landscape: grass strip, hedge
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait image — one single frame. Expand the SAME
scene naturally above (sky) and below (street/pavement) — this is canvas
extension of one photograph, not additional panels. Do not stretch or distort
the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2015
Smartphone era fully arrived. A 2015 station — LED-lit canopy, digital price sign, video ads playing on every pump screen, and a big convenience store.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- pumps with color screens playing ads
- modern canopy with white LED lighting
- price sign showing gas around $2.45
- main sign: "Love's" branded gas station — Love's pole sign with price display and Love's colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: 'ATM INSIDE', 'ANY SIZE COFFEE $1'
- combined trash-and-squeegee stations between the pumps
- a red DVD-rental kiosk by the store entrance
Typography: minimalist flat sans-serif, simplified modern logos.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 7 people TOTAL: 3 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 2 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles; sidewalks busy, driving lanes clear.
- a clerk stacking windshield-washer fluid by the door
- a driver self-serving at the pump
- a woman in yoga pants carrying a green smoothie
Clothing: men in beards, henley shirts; women in infinity scarves, statement necklaces. Fashion palette: coral, mint green, navy. No posing or eye contact. All people on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — the driving lanes stay empty of pedestrians. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 4 period vehicles, all different:
- 2013-2018 Toyota RAV4 — angular compact crossover — white
- 2015-2020 Chevrolet Colorado — mid-size pickup revived — gray
- 2011-2017 Honda Odyssey — lightning-bolt beltline minivan — pearl white
- 2009-2018 Ram 1500 — crosshair grille, refined — dark red
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 2015.
All vehicles obey normal US right-hand traffic flow — parked parallel to the curb, each facing the same direction as its adjacent lane. Nothing sideways, diagonal, or against traffic.
At least one full driving lane in each direction stays clear of parked vehicles, meters, and curb infrastructure — through traffic is never blocked.
One of these vehicles is parked at the pump island with its driver standing beside it refueling.
PLACEMENT: all parked on the RIGHT side of the street with gaps between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, high-visibility crosswalks
- utilities: overhead power lines common, undergrounding in new developments, fiber optic lines on poles

TREES
- deciduous tree at right: mature tree, full canopy
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — digital — DSLR or smartphone camera look.
Color: high saturation. Grain: clean, minimal noise.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
